name: – Cristian Terheş – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2023, Section IV – Court of Justice
part_text:
The European Parliament approves how the European Union's Court of Justice spent its 2023 budget of about 486 million euros. The Parliament's budget control committee checked the court's accounts and found no major problems. The report also asks the court to do more on several fronts: publish a yearly report on gender balance, set up an independent ethics committee, make judges step aside from cases where they may have a conflict of interest, and broadcast all court hearings online.

- The Parliament formally approves the court's 2023 spending and closes the accounts.
- The court is asked to improve ethics rules, gender balance and transparency.
- The court must report back to the Parliament on progress in these areas.
